Cowboy Space had a big media event on Monday night, and while they presented some cool ideas about integrating a datacenter payload into the second stage of a rocket many people thought their goal of a launch by 2028 was overly ambitious and others questioned the concept entirely.

Is there an advantage in building a data center constellation this way?
